cleansingStrength.rationale: C1: defining anionic Sodium Laureth Sulfate (2); further prominent alkyl ether sulfates are reinforcing routes - Sodium Laureth-8 Sulfate (9), Magnesium Laureth Sulfate (11), Magnesium Laureth-8 Sulfate (12), Sodium Oleth Sulfate (14), Magnesium Oleth Sulfate (15) -> strong.
cleansingStrength.counterSignal: Three prominent buffers (Cocamidopropyl Betaine 5, Sodium Cocoyl Glutamate 6, Disodium Cocoamphodiacetate 7) plus Urea (3) and Panthenol (8); the reinforcing sulfates are late, higher-ethoxylated / magnesium oleth types that read as one mild ether-sulfate blend. Convention keeps strong; confidence lowered to moderate.

conditioningLevel.rationale: Cleansing-led architecture: no cationic polymer or conditioner, no silicone, no payload lipid, no protein, no refatter. Only humectants Urea (3), Panthenol (8), Glycerin (20) and pearlizer Glycol Distearate (10).
conditioningLevel.counterSignal: Humectants and pearlizer give some feel but no substantive slip.
